name: EWASCatalog_search_by_cpg
description: NOTE (re-checked 2026-11-01): the 503 reported on 2026-10-09 is gone, but the catalogue is now HTTPS-only -- the old http://ewascatalog.org/api/ answers 404, and this tool has been moved to https://. Look up all published epigenome-wide association study (EWAS) results for one CpG methylation site from the EWAS Catalog (MRC-IEU). Returns trait, effect size, tissue, cohort, and publication for every association, ranked by significance. Example: cpg_id='cg05575921' (AHRR, the strongest known smoking-methylation signal).

name: EWASCatalog_search_by_gene
description: NOTE (re-checked 2026-11-01): the 503 reported on 2026-10-09 is gone, but the catalogue is now HTTPS-only (the old http:// form answers 404) and it cannot deliver its largest gene payloads: gene=AHRR announces Content-Length 2751412 and the connection is closed after 1.57-1.85 MB, at a different offset on every attempt, so that one result set is unobtainable and the tool says so rather than failing to parse. Use EWASAtlas_search_by_gene (EWAS Atlas, curated independently) for a gene this one truncates. Look up all published epigenome-wide association study (EWAS) results annotated to one gene from the EWAS Catalog (MRC-IEU), across every CpG site mapped to it. Returns trait, effect size, tissue, cohort, and publication for each, ranked by significance. Example: gene_symbol='CPT1A' (a canonical smoking/metabolic methylation locus, 1941 associations).
